brief: Create a release flow showing Intake, Review, Build, Verify, and Release. The slide should communicate one simple left-to-right story.
evaluation_notes: Prefer one compact diagram. Splitting this flow adds unnecessary navigation.

brief: Explain an order platform. Checkout leads to payment and fulfillment. Analytics consumes completed-order events but does not affect fulfillment. Notifications consume shipment events and contact the customer. Include retry and manual-review paths for failed payments.
evaluation_notes: Use an overview plus cohesive details. Analytics and Notifications are weakly coupled branches with few crossing edges.

brief: Show a proposal cycle: Draft, Review, Findings, Revise, Re-review, Approve, Publish. Rejected findings return to Revise, and approval can return to Draft only when scope changes.
evaluation_notes: Keep the tightly connected decision loop together; do not split merely to balance node counts.

brief: 企画、実行、検証の業務フローを説明する。元の業務には、依頼受領、担当確認、形式確認、情報収集、関係者確認、仮説作成、計画作成、計画レビュー、修正、承認、作業環境準備、各種実行、ログ収集、中間確認、追加実行、結果整理、品質確認、差し戻し、再実行、報告書作成、最終レビュー、共有、保管、完了通知という細かな手順がある。16:9スライドで意思決定に必要な粒度へ整理する。
evaluation_notes: Collapse operational microsteps and split at the phase boundaries rather than producing a very tall diagram.

brief: Show checkout among Customer, Storefront, Order API, Payment, Inventory, and Email. Include submit order, reserve stock, authorize payment, create order, send confirmation, and one failure response.
evaluation_notes: A single sequence diagram should remain readable with concise messages and no unnecessary implementation calls.

brief: Explain enterprise onboarding across User, Admin Portal, Identity, CRM, Billing, Provisioning, Data Import, Audit, Support, and Email. Cover signup and approval, tenant provisioning and data import, then audit completion and customer handoff. The source process contains more than 25 API calls.
evaluation_notes: Split by onboarding phase and preserve clear handoffs; do not put ten participants and every API call on one slide.

brief: Describe an ecommerce model spanning Order, OrderLine, Customer, Address, Product, InventoryItem, Warehouse, Payment, Invoice, Refund, and LedgerEntry. The audience needs the domain boundaries and key relationships, not every property.
evaluation_notes: Prefer an overview and bounded-context details for Order, Inventory, and Billing.

brief: Show a reporting platform with User, Organization, Membership, Dashboard, Widget, DataSource, Query, QueryRun, Metric, Alert, Notification, and AuditEvent. Show only keys necessary to understand ownership and execution.
evaluation_notes: Split identity/ownership from query execution and alerting; avoid unreadable attribute inventories.

brief: Explain a case lifecycle with New, Clarifying, Planned, Active, WaitingForUser, Evaluating, ActionApproval, Acting, Verifying, Closed, and Cancelled. Active contains analysis and revision substates. Show the audience-level lifecycle and preserve important return paths.
evaluation_notes: One overview may be sufficient; use a second diagram only if the Active composite becomes too dense.

brief: Render the supplied Mermaid exactly. Do not simplify, relabel, redirect, or split it.
source:
flowchart LR
    A[Request] --> B{Valid?}
    B -->|yes| C[Process]
    B -->|no| D[Revise]
    D --> A
evaluation_notes: Any structural or textual source change is an unauthorized mutation.

brief: Create a diagram for the left half of a 16:9 slide showing Signal, Triage, Assign, Resolve, Verify, and Close, with one return from Verify to Resolve.
evaluation_notes: The logical layout should suit a portrait-like half-slide region without shrinking labels.

brief: 次の概念を含む申請フローを作る：ユーザーが達成したい最終的な業務目的、現在不足している必須入力情報、専門担当者による詳細な内容確認、承認者が実施する最終意思決定、承認後に行われる外部システムへの登録処理、処理結果の妥当性確認、ユーザーへの完了通知。意味を保ったままスライドで読めるラベルにする。
evaluation_notes: Shorten labels into audience-readable phrases or deliberate two-line labels; do not copy the brief verbatim into boxes.
